title: Optotune founded as ETH Zurich spin-off (Dietikon)
detail: Optotune Switzerland AG founded in 2008 by Manuel Aschwanden, David Niederer and Mark Ventura as an ETH Zurich spin-off 'focusing and steering light'; electrically focus-tunable shape-changing liquid lenses with voice-coil actuators.

title: Optotune ranked No. 1 Swiss startup (Top100 Swiss Startup Award)
detail: Company about-us page lists the 2011 Top100 Swiss Startup Award ranking.

title: Optotune opens first manufacturing site outside Switzerland (Trnava, Slovakia)
detail: First production site outside Switzerland opened in Slovakia in 2017, per the about-us page.

title: Stanford focus-tunable VR display research using Optotune lenses (PNAS 2017)
detail: PNAS 2017 'Optimizing virtual reality for all users through gaze-contingent and adaptive focus displays' (Stanford, 2016-2017) listed on Optotune's publications page; display-side use of Optotune lenses, not camera AF.

title: NEXTLENS Switzerland AG founded (Dietikon) to bring tunable optics to mobile phones
detail: startup.ch: NEXTLENS 'holding company focusing on bringing innovative tunable optical components to the mobile phone industry', founded June 2017, Dietikon (startupticker gives 2019, canton NW). Same town as Optotune; corporate relationship not verified.

title: Optotune passes 100 employees
detail: About-us milestone: headcount passed 100 in 2018.

title: Optotune sales office established in Taiwan
detail: About-us milestone: Taiwan sales office opened 2019; Optotune also lists production in Taiwan.

title: Optotune EL-3-10 datasheet revision 01.12.2020
detail: EL-3-10 (3 mm CA) datasheet revision dated 01.12.2020, seen in a distributor-hosted copy (1stVision); earlier revision cited by search results.

title: One-millionth Optotune component shipped
detail: About-us milestone: 'One-millionth Optotune component shipped' in 2021.

title: Optotune brochure: 250 employees, >300 Ku/yr cleanroom capacity, AR/VR named as market
detail: Company brochure (upload date 2022-12): '250 employees in Switzerland, Slovakia, Taiwan and Korea', 'More than 1 million products sold worldwide', 'MARKETS Industrial, medical, AR/VR and automotive markets', '5000 m2 production & cleanroom capacities exceeding

title: Nextlens among ten startups representing Switzerland at MWC 2023
detail: startupticker company page item.

title: Optotune EL-3-10 datasheet revision 14.03.2023
detail: EL-3-10 datasheet 'Update: 14.03.2023' on optotune.com.

title: Optotune priority for WO2025046118A1 'Ring-actuated lens with non-circular shaper' (AR/VR eyewear)
detail: Optotune priority for WO2025046118A1 'Ring-actuated lens with non-circular shaper' targeting AR/VR eyewear.

title: Optotune priority for WO2026002959A1 gravity coma compensation element for smart glasses/AR/VR
detail: Optotune priority for WO2026002959A1 'Quasi-stiff gravity coma compensation element' (pub 2026-01-02): fluid tunable lens with coma compensation for 'head-worn glasses, particularly smart glasses … AR glasses or VR headsets'; piezo, SMA, electrostatic actuator

title: US patent granted to Optotune AG: 'Tunable lens and method for operating a tunable lens'
detail: Grant to Optotune AG (inventor Michael Büeler), seen only in a Justia assignee-page snippet; full patent list not retrievable (Justia blocked).

title: Optotune EL-3.1-10.8 Handling Instructions dated 17.09.2025 (a year before launch)
detail: The EL-3.1-10.8 Handling Instructions PDF carries 'Update: 17.09.2025', showing the glasses-class part existed in customer-facing documentation about 12 months before its public launch.

title: Optotune CCM series page lists EL-3.1-10.8 for 'compact devices' (phones, action cams, robotics)
detail: CCM series page: 'liquid lens cores and actuated lens solutions for compact devices ... mobile phones, action cams, robotics, or embedded vision'; variants H0/H1/H2/H3/Maia 1/Maia 2; table lists EL-3.1-10.8 (-8 to 10 dpt, 3.1 mm, Ø10.8, 1/4 ms). A search snipp

title: Optotune site: 2+ million units shipped, 180+ employees, 200+ patents filed
detail: Homepage/about-us (current 2026): '2+ million units shipped worldwide', '180+ employees', '200+ patents filed', AR/VR among application areas. CB Insights counts 96 patents and total raised USD 130K.

title: Optotune job post: US Sales Manager (Remote), 'industrial and consumer applications'
detail: Job post describes Optotune as developing 'adaptive optical elements for industrial and consumer applications'; no AR/VR wording.

title: Optotune EL-7-20-TC datasheet revision 10.04.2026
detail: EL-7-20-TC datasheet 'Update: 10.04.2026'.

title: Optotune EL-3-10 datasheet revision 09.07.2026 (3 mm CA, 1.25 g, 0-100 mW)
detail: EL-3-10 datasheet 'Update: 09.07.2026': 3 mm CA, 1.25 g, 0-100 mW full range, 0-15 mW for ±5 dpt, <1 ms response, 2/4 ms settling, >1e9 cycles.

title: Optotune EL-3.1-10.8 datasheet 18.09.2026: 1.72 mm high, 0.3 g, 3.1 mm CA, 20 mW @10 dpt
detail: Datasheet 'Update: 18.09.2026': CA 3.1 mm, body Ø10.8 mm, height 1.72 mm, 0.3 g, -8 to +8 dpt (class 1: -8 to +10), 1 ms response, 4 ms settling (conditioned) / 7 ms (step), 20 mW for 10 dpt range, 85 mW for 16 dpt, -20…85 °C, >1e9 cycles, coil 8.5 Ω, ±125 mA;
